pages.text: Field notes, the Bulk. The extra dimensions are mined here: $(item)Kaluza-Klein$() everywhere, $(item)Dilaton$() on the Graviton Reefs, $(item)Moduli$() in the Moduli Wastes.

Fauna: $(thing)Brane Striders$() drop $(item)Brane Tension Fiber$(); $(thing)Graviton Wisps$() drop their cores. Both are worth hunting.$(br2)Background: string theory needs 10 dimensions (M-theory 11). The extras are $(thing)compactified$() - curled up too small to see, and their shape fixes the laws of physics we observe.

The $(item)Compactification Lathe$() turns the ores into $(item)Compactified Circles$(), $(item)D-Brane Sheets$() and - with an octonion - $(item)G₂ Manifolds$().$(br2)Membranes are now made from those, and the $(item)M-Theory Core$() unites all eleven dimensions.
A thread pulled from the membrane a Brane Strider walks on.$(br2)Made in $(item)String Resonance Loom$().
A whole dimension rolled up into a circle smaller than a Planck length.$(br2)Made in $(item)Compactification Lathe$().
The surface where open strings end. Our universe might be one.$(br2)Made in $(item)Compactification Lathe$().
Seven curled-up dimensions whose symmetry is the automorphism group of the octonions.$(br2)Made in $(item)Compactification Lathe$().
Eleven dimensions, and all five string theories turn out to be one.$(br2)Made in $(item)Compactification Lathe$().

$(thing)Where these go$():$(li)$(item)Brane Tension Fiber$(): D-Brane Sheet$(li)$(item)Compactified Circle$(): Dimensional Residue, Graviton Crystal, Hopf Fibration, M-Theory Core, String Coupling Crystal and more$(li)$(item)D-Brane Sheet$(): Dimensional Singularity, M-Brane$(li)$(item)G₂ Manifold$(): Dimensional Residue, Dimensional Singularity, E8 Lattice, M-Brane, M-Theory Core$(li)$(item)M-Theory Core$(): Dimensional Singularity, Theory of Everything
